comment_regular: End the current target group without unbinding it. Color buffers whose class predicate at vtable+0x24 is true are queued once for PresentScene vtable+0x28 processing. NiDX9TextureBufferData returns false, so the R32F shadow map is neither queued, copied, nor resolved.
